title: HyENA HIP-3 DEX sunset
preview: All HyENA (hyna) markets will wind down starting from 10:00 UTC on 31 August
content: {"blocks":[{"key":"nac4","text":"All HyENA (hyna) markets will be wound down and halted for trading starting from 31 August 2026 at 10:00 UTC. Traders can close or adjust positions from now until then. Markets are delisted sequentially, with one market entering delisting pricing each hour from 10:00 to 15:00 UTC daily, concluding on 02 September 2026 at 15:00 UTC. No action is required; open positions settle at the final mark price, and USDE margin is returned to spot balance. Refer here for the full settlement mechanics announced by HyENA. HyENA markets include: 1000PEPE-USDE, ADA-USDE, BASED-USDE, BNB-USDE, BTC-USDE, DOGE-USDE, ENA-USDE, ETH-USDE, FARTCOIN-USDE, HYPE-USDE, LINK-USDE, LTC-USDE, PUMP-USDE, SOL-USDE, SUI-USDE, XPL-USDE,
